name: Voice Input
description: Dictate into the composer. whisper.cpp turns your speech into text on this Mac, with no network.

args:
(version 1)
(allow default)
(deny network*)
(deny process-exec)
(allow process-exec (literal "/bin/sh") (literal "/bin/bash") (literal "/bin/dash") (literal "/usr/bin/base64") (subpath "/opt/homebrew") (subpath "/usr/local"))
(deny file-read* (subpath "/Users") (subpath "/Volumes"))
(allow file-read* (regex #"^/Users/[^/]+/\.local/share/whisper/ggml-(base|small)\.en\.bin$"))
(deny file-write*)
(allow file-write* (literal "/dev/null") (subpath "/private/var/folders"))
